capabilities: Run an Apple Shortcut with the selection, line, note, title, path or clipboard as input
Turn favourite shortcuts into command palette commands with hotkeys
Return shortcut output to the cursor, over the selection, at line end or into a property (Pro)
Assign a default shortcut per folder (Pro)
Insert in-note buttons as shortcut code blocks (Pro)
disambiguation: Not a keyboard-shortcut or hotkey tool; it bridges to the Apple Shortcuts app and only works on Apple devices.
extras: Freemium: core features are free; Pro (output handling, folder defaults, buttons) needs a GitHub Sponsors sponsorship, one payment unlocking Pro in all NoteMods plugins. Testing is caveated: links and callback handling were tested on Mac desktop only with a stand-in stub; the Shortcuts app itself, iPhone and iPad were not tested, and screenshots show simulated output. After updates it opens a What's new tab that promotes other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat (disable in settings); sign-in is via the GitHub device flow and sends no note content.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to start an Apple Shortcuts automation on iPhone, iPad or Mac and hand it text from a note.

relations.evidence: The Actions URI plugin works the other way: Shortcuts calls Obsidian.
The Shell commands plugin needs a shell, which iPhone and iPad do not have.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once)

summary: Runs Apple Shortcuts from commands, favourites or note buttons, passing selection, line or note text, with Pro features returning output to notes.
